what: The R116 stick layout's thresholds (P1-C11): the left stick drives, drifts and launches (the boost: a full pull back, then a snap to full forward), the right stick steers and flicks. The wheelie's lift, air time, burst, minimum speed and cooldown are the sim profile's (assets/profiles/cruz-missile.json). Every number is tuned at the playtest and changed here, never in code; crates/jj-input validates the file at load.
